head: b8fb0cb8efdc648e4a4912c56f32f5d7193e9e5b
title: Refund limit checks sum and compare amounts as PHP floats

bugs.note: The requested refund total and the refundable maximum are built with float addition and subtraction and compared with a strict greater-than. Sums such as 18.35 + 11.85 come out as 30.200000000000003, so a refund of exactly the refundable amount is rejected as over the limit.
